title: Ice Tipped PVP pack
description: a pvp Pack that makes all Pvp Related Items and blocks have a new Icy Look!
body:
![The Main Items Changed](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/2e86342f4fd8108759da43a853059928a27a46d2.png)This Texture Pack Adds a New look to PVP Related items and blocks, Giving them a new Icy look! I usually work on this Texture pack once in a while so Expect new Updates on it!
For example, Swords Tips will have ice on it, a Cool detail with this is that if you do a sweep attack it will have a 2nd blue ring symbolizing the Ice on the sword!

> I want to say one last thing about this pack, I would have Put all the older versions of the Pack but my stupid head decieded to legit Wipe all of the old files off my PC and theres no going back pretty much.
